purpose: Locator for the isolated genuine authored browser fixture; not a complete CAD package

author_decisions: All horizontal panels use the same marked local +T face. The end edge is the jig reference; the manufacturer jig defines hole angle and drilling depth.
Three guide stations per horizontal end are spaced 152.4 mm. At the supported depth, end offsets are 22.225 mm, within the manual's edge range.
Back brads are centered on each contacted carcass edge, with 25.4 mm end offsets and at most 180 mm between stations. This placement is authored, not a manufacturer shelf-load specification.

Hardware identification, edge alignment, joint coverage, dependency order and source consistency received a software technical review. Workholding, driver access, thin-back fastening and service behavior require a physical build review.

consumables.description: Wood glue suitable for indoor plywood; apply and cure per the selected adhesive manufacturer's label

hardware.type: Kreg #8 coarse-thread zinc Maxi-Loc pocket-hole screw
DEWALT indoor steel 18-gauge brad, 1-1/4 in length

installation.instruction: Before putting the bookcase into service, select and review tip-over restraint for the actual wall substrate and intended use. No wall anchor is inferred from geometry.

operations.instruction: Cut and label every rough blank from this revision's cut schedule. Preserve grain along local L.
Finish each rough blank to its exact finished L and W in the part schedule. Check actual thickness; rough allowance does not increase thickness.

Check the measured main stock against the Kreg gauge's 3/4 range, set the supplied stop collar to that range, and securely clamp each panel. Use the manufacturer's jig procedure; no drill angle or depth is inferred from CAD.
Mark bottom's local +T face. Align each end with the jig at the three listed stations measured from its front edge; drill the six pockets while the panel is still loose.
Mark shelf_01's local +T face. Align each end with the jig at the three listed stations measured from its front edge; drill the six pockets while the panel is still loose.
Mark shelf_02's local +T face. Align each end with the jig at the three listed stations measured from its front edge; drill the six pockets while the panel is still loose.
Mark top's local +T face. Align each end with the jig at the three listed stations measured from its front edge; drill the six pockets while the panel is still loose.
Dry fit the carcass on a supported work surface. Compare each labeled panel center and each clear opening to this revision's drawing; check squareness before adhesive.

Lay side_left on a supported work surface. Apply the selected glue per its label, clamp each horizontal panel in its drawn position, and seat the three specified pocket screws at each left end without overdriving.
Fit side_right to the horizontal ends, keep the carcass square, clamp the joints and seat three specified screws per right end. Keep the front open for driver access.

Support the square carcass face-down. Transfer the listed carcass-edge centerlines to back, apply wood glue per its label, clamp the back flush, and drive only the specified 1-1/4 in brads on those lines. Check the thin back and all edges for unintended breakout.

Allow adhesive to cure per its label. Check squareness, finished dimensions, clear openings, seated fasteners and breakout. Before use, arrange site-specific tip-over restraint and record the physical review; no shelf load rating is supplied.

review_record.technical_scope: Source, dimensions, local stations, named joint coverage and software dependency checks

source_records.rule: Gauge actual stock, select the 3/4 range stop collar and 1-1/4 in screw; clamp joints. Panel guide stations: 5/8 to 1-1/2 in from edges and 6 to 8 in apart.
source_records.title: KPHJ720/720PRO Global manual, 06/2020 104909 V1, English pages 12-17

source_records.rule: Actual thickness governs selection. Coarse thread is preferred for plywood; zinc pocket screws are for indoor dry use.
source_records.title: Kreg screw guide, updated June 29, 2026

source_records.rule: Published method uses 1-1/4 in pocket screws and wood glue, with a separately attached 1/4 in plywood back, wood glue and 1-1/4 in brads. Original dimensions and quantities are not reused.
source_records.title: Kreg / The Creative Mom Built In Bookcase

source_records.rule: The indoor steel 18-gauge pack includes 1-1/4 in brads. Select that length; do not mix the other pack lengths into this recipe.
source_records.title: DEWALT DWBN18PP 18-gauge brad project pack
